title: Little Haunts Club: A Very Odd Halloween — 15 Printable Coloring Pages
subtitle: A VERY ODD HALLOWEEN
purpose: A carefully art-directed first seasonal Etsy validation product with 15 distinct spooky-cute character archetypes and individually planned scenes. Each page has a readable mini-story, grounded props, open coloring regions, and a deliberate reason for each supporting detail.
audience: older children, teens, and adults who enjoy cozy spooky illustration
visual_bible: Original spooky-cute storybook coloring art for older children, teens, and adults: friendly oddball creatures, small comic mishaps, cozy settings, clear silhouettes, and detail with a purpose. The illustration uses crisp black contour lines on pure white paper, confident outer lines, a few thinner inner contours, broad white coloring areas, and moderate detail that is satisfying at printed page size. Solid black is limited to small accents such as pupils, noses, or tiny markings; clothing, fur, feathers, bones, wings, furniture, and props have clearly enclosed white interiors to color. Frame the portrait scene with a simple rounded rectangle and a generous white margin. Every prop is visibly supported, attached, or held by the character using it. Use warm-hearted expressions and an amusing scene-specific story; never rely on repeated floating bats as filler.
prompt_strategy: Per the FLUX.2 prompting guide, each prompt starts with the main subject and action, then specifies critical line-art style, then adds spatial relationships and scene context. Prompts describe the intended printable linework affirmatively. Each page has a unique art-direction rationale and a targeted defect checklist.
art_direction_principles: One distinct creature archetype per page; ghosts and cats are recurring accents, not the whole cast.
Every page has one focal action and three to five supporting objects that explain the setting.
Small decorative details such as flowers, portraits, pumpkins, a fireplace, a fence, or a framed picture belong to the scene and help composition.
Avoid black-filled environmental panels; backgrounds and character surfaces remain open white coloring regions.
Keep solid black only as a small accent; wings, fur, bones, clothing, bandages, and large props should stay colorable.
Ground and connect every prop; describe object support and attachment explicitly.
Use a simple rounded border, medium-large detail, clear object separation, and a generous printable margin consistently.

research_notes.source: Black Forest Labs FLUX.2 Prompting Guide
research_notes.takeaway: Uses Subject + Action + Style + Context; word order matters; describe desired output instead of relying on negative prompts; structured scene planning is useful for production.
Current ages-7+ book description promotes 45 hand-drawn pages with large bold designs and a varied cast including cozy ghosts, grim reapers, and zombie cats.
A six-page printable listing uses distinct Halloween archetypes such as mummy, vampire, witch, Frankenstein-style monster, cat, and bat, showing that variety can be the product's promise.
Example listings show variety across home scenes and creatures; the strongest lesson is scene diversity plus readable props, not just a higher page count.

Preview imagery includes distinct archetypes and scene ideas such as skeleton at home, mummy, stitched doll, zombie, bride, and grim reaper. Used only as genre-level market research; new prompts use original compositions.

listing.title: Cute Spooky Halloween Coloring Pages for Kids, Teens & Adults — 15 Original Printable PDF + PNG
listing.tagline: A little strange, a little cozy, and full of Halloween charm
listing.description: Meet the Little Haunts Club: a curious cast of friendly spooky neighbors, from a ghostly tailor and patchwork monster to a masked crow apothecary, cozy skeleton reader, tiny witch, vampire baker, and more. Each page tells a small, funny story with pumpkins, flowers, picture frames, cottage details, and other purposeful accents. Original black-outline illustrations with open white areas for your own colors.
listing.price_test: Launch at $2.99 for the initial seasonal validation test. If listing views, favorites, and conversion are healthy, test $3.49; expand the pack or create a companion product before raising the price substantially.

pages.label: 01 · Ghost Tailor Repairs a Bat Cape
pages.scene_title: Ghost Tailor Repairs a Bat Cape
pages.design_rationale: Keeps the strongest existing ghost-tailor idea, but gives the black cat a large colorable body and a clear reason to be in the scene. The sewing machine and framed example communicate the activity immediately.
pages.qa_focus: The cat, ghost, costume fabric, and all props have white open colorable surfaces with clean outlines. Any cape or bat-shaped fabric stays white; no black-filled cape, fur, bird, bat, clothing, framed art, or large prop. Only tiny eyes and facial accents are black. Scene should read as a ghost sewing a costume while the cat watches.
pages.prompt: Printable monochrome coloring-book line art in a portrait page with a clean white margin. A friendly sheet ghost sits at a sturdy sewing table repairing a large WHITE costume cape, while a fluffy cat watches and bats a yarn ball on the floor. Keep the ghost's body, cape, cat's fur, table, thread, scissors, books, folded fabric and all other large surfaces pure white inside clean black outlines. The cape is white colorable fabric, not a black silhouette. No framed bat picture, black bat, black wings, dark costume, shadowed panel, or filled shape. Show a spool of thread, safe scissors on the tabletop, folded blanket on a stool, and one small pumpkin. Clear physical arrangement, crisp consistent outlines, ample open coloring regions, only tiny eyes/mouth details black; no shading, gray, crosshatching, color, filled black, gradient, or text.

pages.label: 02 · Patchwork Monster Builds a Bird Feeder
pages.scene_title: Patchwork Monster Builds a Bird Feeder
pages.design_rationale: Introduces the stitched-monster archetype in an original garden-building scene. The open tray feeder, tools, perched robin, pumpkins, and flowers support the central action without requiring dark enclosed openings.
pages.qa_focus: Check exactly two neck bolts, clear feeder/post contact, hammer held naturally, bird feet touching the feeder roof or perch, a clearly open shallow feeding tray with visible white interior, broad uncluttered overalls, and no enclosed dark aperture.
pages.prompt: A cheerful square-headed patchwork monster child with two small neck bolts and big round eyes fastens a simple wooden bird feeder to a sturdy garden post. The feeder is an open tray design with a small rain roof, a shallow white-bottomed seed tray, and no enclosed box, round entrance, doorway, or dark opening. The monster grips one wooden hammer in one hand while fastening the feeder; the hammer is not on the workbench. Draw an original cute-spooky storybook coloring page in crisp black ink on pure white paper. Use smooth, confident bold outer contours and a smaller number of purposeful inner lines; large enclosed surfaces stay white and open for hand coloring. Characters have rounded friendly proportions, expressive simple faces, and clear silhouettes. Build the scene around one obvious focal action, with medium-large background details that enrich the story without clutter. Use a portrait composition inside a simple rounded-rectangle frame with a generous white margin. Keep props physically grounded and connected: furniture rests on the floor, shelves have clear supports, frames hang on walls, and objects sit on visible surfaces. Reserve solid black for eyes, noses, and a few tiny accents; keep major clothing, feathers, tools, and props as white coloring regions. Scene details: A broad workbench supports three wide spare boards. A tiny robin perches on the feeder roof with both feet touching it. Two large pumpkins and three oversized flowers decorate the foot of the post. A low fence establishes the garden behind the monster. The monster wears simple overalls with two broad patch shapes. The open seed tray has a fully white interior with thin black outlines, no seed fill, and no dark circle.

Do not draw black wings, black feathers, a black bird silhouette or filled black costume. Show a simple white beaked mask, three bottles with open labels, a mortar and a few herbs. The wall is plain white with no window, moon, stars, dark sky, or framed black art. Large surfaces stay pure white and open for coloring. Crisp consistent black line art with clear shape separation, no shading, gray, hatching, color, solid black fills, shadows, gradients, or text.
